rationale: A trial needs an immutable content identity for the exact task it runs. task_name is a human-readable label and may be reused or renamed; trial_digest identifies the whole trial. This digest preserves reproducibility and supports deterministic shard and plan construction.
alternatives: Derive it from trial_digest only if no planner, controller, lock, or receipt needs to address or verify task content independently.
Rename to task_sha256 only if this field is specifically a raw SHA-256 hex digest; otherwise retain the established digest vocabulary and enforce the project-wide digest format.
simplestChoice: Keep task_digest as the required immutable task-content reference.
